# Kitty graphics fixtures: what the PTY parser observes and what the relay
# and upload assembler make of it, fed whole, split at every byte boundary,
# and byte by byte (see TestKittyGraphicsFixtures).
#
# name | outcomes | visible text | sequence
#
# outcomes, one per observed command ("-": none observed):
#   reject   parsed, refused by ValidateKittyGraphicsRelay
#   command  a valid non-upload command (placement, delete, query)
#   partial  a valid upload chunk; more must follow
#   upload   completes a valid static image upload
#   invalid  a valid chunk the assembler refuses (bad image or sequence)
# visible text is line 0 of the screen afterwards: graphics never print.
# The sequence uses Go string escapes; {X*n} repeats X n times.
